added_lines: – The Committee would like to express their thanks to all who attended the prayers in the cemetery on the Feast of All Saints. The prayers were led by Fr. Mark Quinn. Music and song were provided by the Cortoon Community Choir, while the Rosary was led by Mary Neenan. The public address system was provided by Seamus Roache, and the Lowery family had the cemetery looking splendid. Thank you to everyone who joined us and helped make the occasion so prayerful and meaningful as we remembered our deceased loved ones. Immediately after the prayers, Galway County Council gave a presentation in Cortoon Hall on the recently completed digital mapping of the graveyard and explained how to access this valuable resource online. The Committee also wishes to thank all who contributed to the collection, which helps support the ongoing upkeep and maintenance of the cemetery. Looking ahead, the Cortoon Graveyard Committee plans to hold an outdoor Mass in the cemetery on 4th July 2027 at 11.00 am. This Mass will replace the annual prayers held in the graveyard in November. Tuam (Cathedral Parish)
